causalScope: Actual selected tab/session/draft context6-12 must commit natively and receive its associated normal postcommit status publication. Pre-arm in-flight operations remain observed; account, lock, error and fork transitions fail closed.

Own-method descriptors, this, arguments, returned plans, handles and original promises are preserved. The mutation callback identity is wrapped; added promise reactions handle rejection. Cleanup restores descriptors and unsubscribes; no flush, snapshotNow or disposal creates readiness.

All held current-socket responses complete after the selection cursor: successful resumes send history then status; failed resumes send exactly SESSION_LOAD_ERROR with no requestId/turnId/failure payload, while connect finally sends the captured thinking status. No invented request ID or generic-error count is used.

Healthy completion is followed by finite rendering before the unchanged original streaming assertion. Explicit escaped outcomes bypass only that added render and reach the original assertion; a supplementary assertion rejects healing.

All three final lifecycle snapshots have pending=true. Later scroll/selection work remains possible. The single native writer, unchanged account/content, observed no-fork version publication and host-sequence fences justify later context-only writes in this exact fixture; this is not a global drain.

Same erroneous finishAssistantMessage(sessionId) call inside unchanged special error handler fails both original streaming assertions. No test matcher/action is changed.
